{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge merino turtleneck, regular fit, hip length, deep burgundy #6B2737, wool

Straight-leg trousers, high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey #3A3D42, wool-blend flannel

Tailored long coat, single-breasted, knee to mid-calf length, camel #B58B5A, wool-cashmere blend

Leather ankle boots, block heel of moderate height, lug-free grip sole, black #1C1C1C, smooth leather

Thick knit scarf, wide and long, oatmeal #CBBBA0, soft wool

Lined leather gloves, wrist length, black #1C1C1C, leather with a warm lining

Structured tote bag, medium size, fits a laptop and documents, dark brown #4A3224, grained leather

This outfit works because it follows the neat business code: a refined knit with wool trousers and ankle boots reads polished and professional at the office. The layers are built for a frosty autumn walk, with a warm turtleneck, a long coat, a scarf and lined gloves keeping her comfortable on the way. The block heel and grippy sole give steady footing on cold pavement, and the restrained palette of burgundy, charcoal and camel looks put-together while the warm tones soften the cold-weather greys."}
